annotations.title: Read any page of the site

description: Any page of anchorterminal.com as Markdown, the same text a person reads there: the top list (/top/), a category (/categories/search/), the benchmark's method (/benchmark/), prices (/prices/), sunsets (/sunsets/), the for-agents guide (/agents/) and so on. path is the page's path; format markdown (default), slim or json. The site's guide for agents: https://www.anchorterminal.com/agents/

format.description: markdown (the default), slim for the fewest tokens, or json

path.description: The page's path on the site, e.g. /top/ or /categories/search/
